movie.title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
movie.overview: A petty criminal fakes insanity to serve his sentence in a mental ward rather than prison. He soon finds himself as a leader to the other patients—and an enemy to the cruel, domineering nurse who runs the ward.

facts: Did you know the iconic 1975 film actually began as a 1962 novel penned by Ken Kesey? It's the original source of the unforgettable story!
Before the silver screen, the story of 'One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest' first hit the stage! There was a 1963 play adaptation, which set the groundwork for the famous movie.
And here's a fun tidbit about that 1963 stage version: none other than Hollywood legend Kirk Douglas starred in it! Imagine him bringing the character to life years before Jack Nicholson.
